statement: Under uniform score error epsilon_b on every relevant state-action pair, the greedy finite-horizon reachability policy satisfies 0 <= V_B^*(x0)-V_B^pi(x0) <= 2 sum_{b=1}^B epsilon_b.

quantifiers.initial_state: every x0 whose relevant trajectories and actions lie in the audited domain
quantifiers.score_sequence: every sequence satisfying the stagewise uniform error bounds
quantifiers.transition_kernel: every probability kernel for which the Bellman quantities are defined

proof_obligations: The greedy action's optimal Q-value loss is at most 2 epsilon_b.
Integration against a probability kernel preserves a pointwise continuation-regret upper bound.
The Bellman regret recursion is at most 2 epsilon_b plus the previous bound.
Natural-number induction yields the cumulative sum.
Optimality of V^* gives nonnegative regret.
verification_condition: An exact proof kernel validates the one-step and induction certificates, an independent SMT reconstruction finds no violating real assignment, and a valid reachability MDP attains the factor 2 at B=1.
